chapter: Fats Waller, Zululand and the ideal band
title: The planned college tour with Art Hodes
summary: He describes the 1973 tour with Hodes, Slam Stewart, Barney Bigard and Barrett Deems.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Oh, when I lived in Washington I used to go any time Slam Stewart arrived in town.
Isn't he terrific?
Oh yes.
And did you ever meet a sweeter guy?
I don't, I never knew him, I never knew him.
Oh he's beautiful. I'm going on the road after this, after the first of the year and we're going to colleges all over the Country.
Oh very good.
Slam Stewart is on bass. Barney (Bigard) is on clarinet.
Oh no.
Yes. Art (Hodes) is on piano. Barrett Deems on drums, he used to be with Louis Armstrong.
And so did Barney Bigard.
Well, do you know some of the places that you're going? Some of the schools?
Well I have the itinerary at home.
You don't have it with you?

It just says the name of the town that we're going. And I don't have the names of the schools as yet. Where we are actually going to play. But I do know, have the towns you know. I know we open in Greenwich, Connecticut and then we go some place in Pennsylvania and so on and so forth. All over the Country and Canada. It will be three months there.

Well there are two reasons for my asking. Of course number one, I lecture all over the Country in colleges myself and I have vast connections and I will certainly send word ahead if you're going to any of the places where I know people. But the other thing is that I myself would like to come when it's convenient to hear this group. This would be oh, a marvelous experience, for me, I really would.
It will be a beautiful group. Because we are all mature musicians and dedicated to our
music. Because every time we get up there to play believe me, we're trying our best. And when you're with a bunch of guys that are fine musicians and fine persons, fine human beings.....
Now who put the group together?
Well actually Art (Hodes?) did but he asked me who we should get on bass and I said, get Slam Stewart, that's it. And so that should be, that's something to look forward to.
May I ask you then to send me the itinerary? (LAUGHTER).
Yes, I'll have Marian....
Because I'm serious about that. I really would like to, wherever the nearest place is that fits in with my own time schedule.
Well that would be, let's see, we open the 4th of January 1973 for those listening. (LAUGHTER).
And you don't even know where you open though, huh? (LAUGHTER).
In Greenwich, Connecticut some place.
Oh, that's right you said in Greenwich.
